title: USDT is not applicable for IERC20Minimal interface
summary: _Resolved_  ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  When users want to increase liquidity, users can do liquidity via the function `_executeLiquidityIncrease`. In function `_executeLiquidityIncrease`, we will transfer assets to UniswapV3Staker, and then approve asset token to the `nonfungiblePositionManager`. The problem here is that USDT token does not support `IERC20Minimal(token0).approve` interface. This will cause this transaction to be reverted.
